# Database schema

<!-- Generated by `npm run schema` from a fresh database (schema.sql + migrations.js). Don't edit by hand. -->

The database is at **version 19**. `schema.sql` made version 1 (users and sessions);
every later change is a migration in `migrations.js`, run once on startup by any database that
doesn't have it yet (with a backup first). To change the schema, add a migration, then run
`npm run schema`.

| Version | Change |
|---|---|
| 1 | accounts and login sessions (`schema.sql`, M7) |
| 2 | admin role (plan §11, A3) |
| 3 | AI-generated games (plan §11, A3) |
| 4 | game versions: change requests make new versions (plan §12e, K6) |
| 5 | designs first: a version is designed, approved, then built (plan §13i, F5) |
| 6 | every build attempt is kept (plan §13n) |
| 7 | users' own GenAI Studio keys, encrypted (plan §15, A7) |
| 8 | catalogue entries, votes and bios (plan §16) |
| 9 | how each build attempt was written: whole file or edits (plan §23) |
| 10 | bug reports: from the site-wide form, and on each game page with votes (plan §31) |
| 11 | asking for a game to be published, and the admin sending it back (plan §44) |
| 12 | the code review after every build, and "Review again" versions (plan §47) |
| 13 | no more asking an admin to publish: creators publish their own games (plan §49) |
| 14 | remixes: a game copied from another to change (plan §45) |
| 15 | a remix's own design: "Make it your own" versions (plan §45b) |
| 16 | uploaded game files (plan §57) |
| 17 | site reports about a game's content (plan §57) |
| 18 | a remix remembers how its original was made (plan §60) |
| 19 | games played: every game that ends in a room, finished or stopped |

## build_attempts

Every attempt at building a version: the code the model wrote and what the checks found (plan §13n).

| Column | Type | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `game_id` | TEXT | part of the primary key, not null, → game_versions.game_id (on delete: cascade) |  |
| `version` | INTEGER | part of the primary key, not null, → game_versions.version (on delete: cascade) |  |
| `build` | INTEGER | part of the primary key, not null |  |
| `attempt` | INTEGER | part of the primary key, not null |  |
| `ok` | INTEGER | not null | 1: passed every check |
| `source` | TEXT |  | NULL if the reply had no game file |
| `report_json` | TEXT |  | the checks' report (without screenshots) |
| `seconds` | INTEGER |  | how long the model took |
| `prompt_tokens` | INTEGER |  |  |
| `completion_tokens` | INTEGER |  |  |
| `created_at` | INTEGER | not null |  |
| `mode` | TEXT | check (mode IN ('whole', 'edits')) |  |

## game_pages

What a game's creator changed about how it's shown in the catalogue, never the game file (plan §16). NULL: what the file says.

| Column | Type | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `game_id` | TEXT | primary key |  |
| `name` | TEXT |  |  |
| `description` | TEXT |  |  |
| `about` | TEXT |  |  |
| `tags_json` | TEXT |  |  |
| `minutes_json` | TEXT |  |  |
| `main_shot` | TEXT | check (main_shot IN ('host', 'phone')) |  |
| `updated_by` | INTEGER | → users.id (on delete: set null) |  |
| `updated_at` | INTEGER | not null |  |
| `allow_remix` | INTEGER | not null, default 1, check (allow_remix IN (0, 1))) |  |

## game_plays

Every game that ended in a room: which game and version, and whether it was stopped (and why). Nothing about the players. No foreign key on game_id, like game_pages.

| Column | Type | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | primary key |  |
| `game_id` | TEXT | not null |  |
| `version` | INTEGER |  | which version was played (NULL: an official game) |
| `stopped` | TEXT | check (stopped IS NULL OR stopped IN ('host', 'reload', 'unresponsive', 'broken')) | NULL: the big screen ended it |
| `ended_at` | INTEGER | not null |  |

Index `game_plays_by_game` on `game_id`.

## game_report_votes

Up/down votes on game reports: one per account per report. The total is their sum (plan §31b).

| Column | Type | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `report_id` | INTEGER | part of the primary key, not null, → game_reports.id (on delete: cascade) |  |
| `user_id` | INTEGER | part of the primary key, not null, → users.id (on delete: cascade) |  |
| `value` | INTEGER | not null, check (value IN (-1, 1)) |  |

## game_reports

Bug reports on a game's page (plan §31b). No foreign key on game_id, like game_pages.

| Column | Type | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | primary key |  |
| `game_id` | TEXT | not null |  |
| `user_id` | INTEGER | not null, → users.id (on delete: cascade) |  |
| `body` | TEXT | not null |  |
| `device` | TEXT |  |  |
| `fixed_at` | INTEGER |  |  |
| `created_at` | INTEGER | not null |  |

Index `game_reports_by_game` on `game_id`.

## game_versions

One version of an AI-made game: from the idea (v1) or a change request. Holds its design, code and check report.

| Column | Type | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `game_id` | TEXT | part of the primary key, not null, → generated_games.id (on delete: cascade) |  |
| `version` | INTEGER | part of the primary key, not null |  |
| `request` | TEXT | not null |  |
| `based_on` | INTEGER |  |  |
| `changelog` | TEXT |  |  |
| `model` | TEXT |  |  |
| `status` | TEXT | not null, check (status IN ('designing', 'design_ready', 'generating', 'failed', 'ready')) |  |
| `design` | TEXT |  | the latest draft; once built, the design it was built from |
| `drafts_json` | TEXT |  | every draft: [{ text, by: 'ai' \| 'admin', feedback?, at }] |
| `design_feedback` | TEXT |  | what the admin asked to change, while a new draft is written |
| `name` | TEXT |  |  |
| `description` | TEXT |  |  |
| `source` | TEXT |  |  |
| `source_sha256` | TEXT |  |  |
| `report_json` | TEXT |  |  |
| `error` | TEXT |  |  |
| `created_at` | INTEGER | not null |  |
| `updated_at` | INTEGER | not null |  |
| `code_review_json` | TEXT |  |  |
| `kind` | TEXT | check (kind IS NULL OR kind IN ('recheck', 'remix', 'upload')) |  |

## game_votes

Up/down votes: one per account per game (plan §16).

| Column | Type | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `game_id` | TEXT | part of the primary key, not null |  |
| `user_id` | INTEGER | part of the primary key, not null, → users.id (on delete: cascade) |  |
| `value` | INTEGER | not null, check (value IN (-1, 1)) |  |
| `created_at` | INTEGER | not null |  |

## genai_keys

A user's own GenAI Studio key, encrypted; the secret that opens it is not in the database (plan §15).

| Column | Type | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | INTEGER | primary key, → users.id (on delete: cascade) |  |
| `ciphertext` | BLOB | not null |  |
| `iv` | BLOB | not null |  |
| `tag` | BLOB | not null |  |
| `last4` | TEXT | not null |  |
| `created_at` | INTEGER | not null |  |

## generated_games

An AI-made game (plan §11). Its versions are in game_versions.

| Column | Type | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | TEXT | primary key | "g-..." chosen by the server; also the game's id |
| `owner_user_id` | INTEGER | not null, → users.id (on delete: cascade) |  |
| `prompt` | TEXT | not null | the idea the game was generated from |
| `created_at` | INTEGER | not null |  |
| `updated_at` | INTEGER | not null |  |
| `published_version` | INTEGER |  |  |
| `playtest_version` | INTEGER |  |  |
| `remix_of` | TEXT |  |  |
| `remix_of_version` | INTEGER |  |  |
| `remix_of_name` | TEXT |  |  |
| `remix_of_made_by` | TEXT | check (remix_of_made_by IS NULL OR remix_of_made_by IN ('ai', 'upload'))) |  |

## sessions

One row per logged-in browser. Only a SHA-256 hash of the cookie token is stored.

| Column | Type | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token_hash` | TEXT | primary key |  |
| `user_id` | INTEGER | not null, → users.id (on delete: cascade) |  |
| `created_at` | INTEGER | not null |  |
| `expires_at` | INTEGER | not null |  |

Index `sessions_by_expiry` on `expires_at`.

## site_reports

Sent from the /report form, by anyone: logged out, user_id is NULL (plan §31c).

| Column | Type | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | primary key |  |
| `user_id` | INTEGER | → users.id (on delete: set null) |  |
| `page` | TEXT |  |  |
| `body` | TEXT | not null |  |
| `device` | TEXT |  |  |
| `done_at` | INTEGER |  |  |
| `created_at` | INTEGER | not null |  |
| `kind` | TEXT | not null, default 'other', check (kind IN ('bug', 'idea', 'content', 'other'))) |  |

## users

One row per account. Passwords are stored only as scrypt hashes.

| Column | Type | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | primary key |  |
| `username` | TEXT | unique, any capitalization counts as the same, not null |  |
| `password_hash` | TEXT | not null |  |
| `created_at` | INTEGER | not null | ms since 1970 (Date.now()) |
| `is_admin` | INTEGER | not null, default 0 |  |
| `bio` | TEXT |  |  |
